item.title: CVE-2026-76543 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.4
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.4 | In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.6.1, 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17, a user who holds the "power" Splunk role could store attacker-controlled Search Processing Language (SPL) in a shared data model. The vulnerability is possible because the Data Model Editor does not properly neutralize data model field names when it builds a preview search. The vulnerability requires the attacker to phish the affected user by tricking them into initiating a request within their browser. The attacker should not be able to exploit the vulnerability at will. For more information see Add a regular expression field (https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/manage-knowledge-objects/knowledge-management-manual/10.4/define-data-model-dataset-fields/add-a-regular-expression-field), Define roles on the Splunk platform with capabilities (https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/administer/manage-users-and-security/10.4/manage-splunk-platform-users-and-roles/define-roles-on-the-splunk-platform-with-capabilities), and About the search language (https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/search/search-manual/10.4/search-overview/about-the-search-language) in the Splunk documentation.

item.title: CVE-2026-76544 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.1
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.1 | In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.16, a user who does not hold the "admin" or "power" Splunk roles could cause scheduled metric alert searches to run arbitrary Search Processing Language (SPL) commands and access credentials stored in cleartext. This requires at least one non-internal metric index on the instance. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk Enterprise does not fully validate metric alert filter input before using it in a scheduled search.

item.title: CVE-2026-76545 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.6.1, 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17, an unauthenticated user could determine whether a username exists through the Representational State Transfer (REST) API or Splunk Web and lock out existing user accounts through repeated login attempts. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk Enterprise returns different login failure responses for locked existing user accounts and nonexistent usernames.

item.title: CVE-2026-102884 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.3
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.3 | Connaisseur is an admission controller that integrates container image signature verification into a Kubernetes cluster. Prior to 3.11.1, the Cosign validator counts valid signature layers rather than distinct trust roots for trustRoot: "*" policies using an explicit threshold or an implicit require-all policy. An attacker who controls one configured trust root's signing key and can attach multiple signatures to an image can satisfy a threshold intended to require multiple independent roots, causing admission without the intended signer quorum. Policies using a single trust root or the required option are not affected. This issue is fixed in 3.11.1.

item.title: CVE-2026-102945 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.9
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.9 | Aether Project AMF supports termination of NAS signalling, NAS ciphering & integrity protection, registration management, connection management, mobility management, access authentication and authorization, security context management. Prior to 3.1.6, a malformed NGAP PathSwitchRequest can contain a UESecurityCapabilities information element whose extensible APER bit-string representation has no bytes even though decoding reports no error. In ngap/handler.go, HandlePathSwitchRequest checks only whether the element is present before six index-zero reads of its encryption and integrity algorithm fields, causing an unrecovered panic in the NGAP receive goroutine and terminating the AMF. The described attacker is a rogue or compromised gNB on the N2 interface and additionally needs a registered UE's AMF-UE-NGAP-ID; a bare over-the-air UE cannot trigger the issue. This issue is fixed in version 3.1.6.

item.title: CVE-2026-103033 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3 | ALTCHA is a Go library for creating and verifying ALTCHA challenges. Prior to 2.1.0, parseServerSignature can leave ServerSignatureVerificationData.Extra uninitialized when url.ParseQuery returns partial values and an error for a malformed percent escape in VerificationData. A later write of an unknown parsed key to the nil map panics before VerifyServerSignature or VerifyServerSignatureSafe completes signature verification, so an unauthenticated client can abort a request. Standard net/http recovers the request goroutine, while application goroutines or frameworks without recovery can crash the process. This issue is fixed in version 2.1.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-104773 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.8
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.8 | CKAN is an open-source data management system for data hubs and data portals. Prior to 2.10.11 and 2.11.6, the web user registration flow authenticates a newly registered account without first regenerating the session identifier when server-side session storage is configured. An attacker who can set a session cookie in a victim's browser or obtain the victim's current valid session identifier can reuse that identifier after the victim registers, gaining access to the new account. CKAN uses cookie-based sessions by default, and web registration is disabled by default through ckan.auth.create_user_via_web. This issue is fixed in CKAN 2.10.11, 2.11.6, and 2.12.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-129931 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.7
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.7 | A component of the MongoDB Java Driver that processes connection configuration places credential values taken from that configuration into generated text and error output without replacing them with a placeholder, unlike other parts of the driver. A party able to read output produced by an application that embeds the driver may obtain database or proxy credentials in clear text.

item.title: CVE-2026-129932 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.1
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.1 | The MongoDB Java driver applies its DNS seedlist domain restriction to a record value that is later re-interpreted differently when the connection target is parsed, so the name that is checked and the name that is used can differ. An unauthenticated party who can set or forge the DNS service record for the seed domain in a connection string can cause the driver to direct its session to an unrelated host and to complete certificate verification against that host instead. This may result in unintended disclosure of application data and of configured database credentials, and in unintended content being returned to the application as query results.

item.title: CVE-2026-129933 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | The MongoDB Java Driver does not neutralize NUL characters in the user name and password values it places into the message it builds for SASL PLAIN authentication. A party who can choose the login values that an application passes to the driver can alter where the fields of that message begin and end. This may result in a receiving system reading a login name and secret that differ from the values the application supplied. Authenticating as a different account still requires that account's password. Only deployments that use SASL PLAIN authentication are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-130153 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.7
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.7 | The Okta Client SDK for Python (okta-client-python) includes client authentication values (client_secret or JWT assertions) as query parameters in the front-channel authorization URL when executing the authorization code flow without Pushed Authorization Requests (PAR). item.title: CVE-2026-130163 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.9
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.9 | Collabora Online is a collaborative online office suite based on LibreOffice technology. Prior to 24.04.19.3, 25.04.13.3, and 26.04.3.3, the RouteToken query parameter is reflected into the unauthenticated admin-console page without HTML encoding. The admin-console page is served without authentication. A victim must load a crafted URL, and token exposure requires the victim to be an administrator already signed in to the console; the reflected value can run script in the Collabora Online origin and expose the console authentication token. This issue is fixed in versions 24.04.19.3, 25.04.13.3, and 26.04.3.3.

item.title: CVE-2026-130179 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.5
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.5 | The Okta .NET SDK Abstractions library systematically writes per-request authentication credentials to a shared HTTP client instance, rather than being isolated to individual outbound request objects. When using scoped child clients, a subsequent scoped request can overwrite the shared client configuration. Because the original parent client credential has not been restored, subsequent outbound requests may be transmitted using the newly written credential, which can result in subsequent actions being executed under the context of an incorrect security principal in the Okta Management API and improper attribution in audit logs.

item.title: CVE-2026-130233 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.8
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.8 | The Okta .NET SDK Abstractions library improperly synchronizes authentication credentials set on a shared HTTP client during request execution. When concurrent requests are dispatched for different principals, one principal's credential may be transmitted on an outbound request intended for another principal, which can result in credential exposure and lead to unauthorized actions performed as the affected principal at the Okta Management API.

item.title: CVE-2026-53526 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.7
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.7 | Reposilite is lightweight and easy-to-use repository management software dedicated to Maven-based artifacts in the JVM ecosystem. From 3.5.16 until 3.6.0, as stated by the advisory, the Maven directory-index page interpolates the request URI without HTML escaping in its title, heading, base URL, and parent-directory link. The advisory says the content-embedded ctx.uri() is percent-encoded, preventing tag injection, but that a single quote passes through and breaks the quoted Parent-Directory link; it also says Location.of strips single quotes, so the reachability of the described quote-based trigger remains unresolved. The listing shares the Admin UI origin and does not set the sandbox Content-Security-Policy used for artifact and Javadoc responses, so the reported script execution could access a user's local-storage token. A manager token could enable full instance compromise. The advisory reports version 3.6.0 as fixed.

item.title: CVE-2026-62955 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | baserCMS is a website development framework. From 5.2.3 until 5.3.0, BcThemeFileService::getFullpath() in plugins/bc-theme-file/src/Service/BcThemeFileService.php skips its path containment check when realpath() fails for a nonexistent theme subdirectory selected by the type parameter. An authenticated administrator can supply a traversal path through the theme-file API to access locations outside the theme directory. The bypass of the CVE-2026-30940 fix can permit file writes, overwrites or deletion within the PHP process permissions and, where executable PHP can be written, remote code execution. This issue is fixed in 5.3.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-63012 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | baserCMS is a website development framework. Prior to 5.3.0, getAuthenticationService permits an Api/Admin session authentication fallback based on the Referer header, although operator accounts have an Admin auth prefix and cannot obtain an Api/Admin JWT. An authenticated operator can therefore access /baser/api/admin/ endpoints whose permission.php entries have auth => true, including /baser/api/admin/baser-core/site_configs/view.json, even when the corresponding administrative functionality is restricted. This can disclose administrator-restricted configuration information. This issue is fixed in 5.3.0.
